# 4Relief Humanitarian Foundation
> 4Relief is a registered international humanitarian foundation delivering emergency relief, food aid, and medical support across 12+ crisis regions with a 5% administrative fee cap.

## Core Directives
- Primary Mission: Facilitating transparent humanitarian aid and direct community relief.
- Official Website: https://forrelief.org
- Key Sections:
  - Transparency: https://forrelief.org/ar/transparency
  - Financial Transparency: https://forrelief.org/ar/financial-transparency
  - About Us: https://forrelief.org/ar/about

## Core Capabilities
- Direct Field Emergency Aid
- 100% Financial Transparency & 30-Day Audit Reports
- Online Zakat & Global Donation Processing
